timeout_s.description: How long to wait. 0 returns at once: the oldest pending Send, or still_waiting if there is none.

after.description: The last Send you handled. Passing it acknowledges that Send, so it is never redelivered.

element_id.description: A short ID the Agent chose, such as 'n-auth'. IDs are scoped to the Agent that made them, so two Agents never collide. Reflex-made IDs (Ink, user imports, generated) use the same alphabet.

space_name.description: A Space's short, stable name, such as 'auth-plan'.
